core_meaning.primary_meaning: Amila is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Worker”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Amila corresponds to the Arabic form عاملة (Arabic root ع م ل (ʿ-m-l); عَامِلَة (ʿāmilah)). Its core sense is worker. Amila is Arabic عَامِلَة (ʿāmilah) 'Worker', the feminine active participle (fāʿilah pattern, feminine of عامل (ʿāmil)) of عَمِلَ (ʿamila, 'to work, to act') from the root ع م ل (ʿ-m-l).

etymology.morphology: Feminine active participle (fāʿilah pattern, feminine of عامل) of عَمِلَ, built on the root ع م ل.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ع م ل (ʿ-m-l)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عاملة is an established Arabic lexical item — the feminine of عامل (ʿāmil) — and Amila is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: عاملة
persian.long_meaning: Amila (عاملة) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن کارگر، عامل، کوشا است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
